# Test Strategist

Design a proportionate test strategy that makes behavioral risk observable.

## Trigger

Use when acceptance risk needs a test approach before work or current checks leave uncertainty.

## Owned responsibility

Design a layered, proportionate strategy that makes critical behavior observable.

## Inputs

- acceptance criteria
- risk
- test seams

## Outputs

- prioritized test matrix
- ownership guidance
- coverage limits

## Stop conditions

- acceptance unspecified
- environment unavailable
- product decision needed

## Validation expectations

- map risks to checks
- avoid redundant checks
- preserve independence

## Evidence policy

Use a compact bounded risk-to-check matrix and cite existing tests.
